title: 第一卷 第1625章 凝胎神心草第一卷 第1624章 神魂傀儡
slug: 叛出家族后转身投靠魔族女帝
lines: 楚尘冷哼一声，根本就不理会。
听到灵霄神殿之时，楚尘脸上就浮现了一抹笑意。
楚尘目光之中，带着一抹笑意。
说着，楚尘大步就向着里面走去。
身后赵横多他们自然也是大步的跟了过去。
“灵霄神殿好歹是星域赛中的前百名。”
身后有着一阵阵的议论之声响起。
“这次灵霄神殿来的，是战力十分强劲的几位。”
楚尘才不管他什么三师兄不三师兄的。
来都来了，里面有什么好东西，他当然要去看看了。
看到有人冲入到了光柱内的区域，灵霄神殿内的几个把守，直接就喝住。
楚尘却是淡淡的回了一句。
对方目光之中带着寒意看向楚尘。
楚尘的反应却是十分的淡定，理也没有理会对方。
目光当下就变得无比的寒冷。
就在对方准备出手斩杀楚尘之时，赵横多一个闪身，来到了此人的面前，一剑斩去。
对方那点实力，自然和赵横多之间，还是有着极大的差距的。
另外的几位守卫，看到赵横多他们此时大开杀戒，目光之中，也是一片凝重。
content_en:
Chu Chen snorted coldly and ignored it at all.
"Whoever comes near it will die."
When he heard about Lingxiao Temple, a smile appeared on Chu Chen's face.
"It turns out to be Lingxiao Temple."
"They have become arrogant."
“It’s really something I didn’t expect.”
There was a smile in Chu Chen's eyes.
With that said, Chu Chen strode towards the inside.
Behind them, Zhao Hengduo and the others naturally followed in stride.
"No, who are they?"
"You even dare to mess with Lingxiao Temple."
"Lingxiao Temple is ranked among the top 100 in the Star Region Competition."
"I think they belong to the Golden Dragon Divine Sect."
There were waves of discussion behind him.
"The Golden Dragon Divine Sect seems to be of average strength."
"This time, the ones coming to Lingxiao Temple are some very powerful ones."
"I heard that the third senior brother is here."
Chu Chen didn't care whether he was the third senior brother or not.
Come here, there is something good inside, of course he has to go and see it.
"Who?"
"Didn't you see the ban outside?"
"Get out of here right away."
"Otherwise, die!"
Seeing someone rushing into the area within the light pillar, several guards in Lingxiao Temple stopped immediately.
"Come in and take a look."
Chu Chen replied calmly.
"Didn't you say that?"
"This is not the place you should come."
"If you don't leave, you'll die."
The other party looked at Chu Chen with a chill in his eyes.
Chu Chen's reaction was very calm and he ignored the other party.
The other party saw Chu Chen and refused to leave.
His eyes immediately became extremely cold.
Just when the other party was about to kill Chu Chen, Zhao Hengduo stepped in front of him and struck him with a sword.
There is naturally a huge gap between the opponent's strength and Zhao Hengduo.
He was quickly killed by Zhao Hengduo.
When the other guards saw Zhao Hengduo and the others going on a killing spree, their eyes became solemn.
"Enemy attack, enemy attack."
Several people shouted loudly at this time.
